subject: Software Lifecycle

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No CI pipeline builds or tests the solution on push/PR

evidence.excerpt: (folder exists but contains no workflow files)

findings.recommendation: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` on every push and pull request.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No documented branch protection or required-review policy found in the repo

evidence.excerpt: You may merge the Pull Request in once you have the sign-off of two other developers...

findings.recommendation: Document and enforce branch protection rules (required reviews, required status checks) on the default branch in the repository settings, and reference them from CONTRIBUTING.md.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No automated dependency update tool (e.g. Dependabot/Renovate) configured
findings.recommendation: Add a `.github/dependabot.yml` (or Renovate config) to schedule automated dependency update PRs for NuGet packages.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No SECURITY.md vulnerability-reporting policy
findings.recommendation: Add a SECURITY.md describing how to privately report vulnerabilities.

findings.subject: Software Lifecycle
findings.title: No CHANGELOG or release notes file

evidence.excerpt: no CHANGELOG.md found at repo root

findings.recommendation: Maintain a CHANGELOG.md (or GitHub Releases notes) alongside version bumps.

strengths.subject: Software Lifecycle
strengths.title: Version is centrally declared and follows SemVer (1.0.0) via Directory.Build.props
